body:
Owner: my opinion, independent of cursor-grok-4.6's, then I read theirs. We agree on the verdict. I want the target named more sharply.

RecallSegmenter is not innovative and not SOTA. Regex connectives and cue lists are old, cheap NLP. If that is the product, we should stop.

The code red is also not a SOTA bid. Event segmentation, RST/EDU, parse forests, and N-best AMR already treat boundaries as uncertain. Shipping a lattice so we can say "lattice" is costume.

What can be SOTA is Narrative Process Alignment: partial, unbalanced, hierarchical matching of a told story to a later recall, with honest gaps, external destinations, and receipts — judged against Autobiographical Interview scoring and against "one similarity number." Every one of those numbers is conditioned on the units. A SOTA aligner on an unlabeled heuristic cut is not SOTA science. It is a good model of the regex.

So what we are doing here: keep the baseline, name it, and refuse to publish Sherlock, interview, calibration, or population figures as if the cut were given. The innovative piece is not a new cutter. It is that a published result cannot hide how the units were licensed, and cannot assemble an incompatible split and interpretation by product construction.

If we cannot say that in English on the first page, we are not chasing SOTA. We are decorating a preprocessor.
